bullets.text: A pet dog died in an apartment fire in Pallikaranai after occupants lit a wooden pooja lamp, and the office should monitor fire safety compliance in high-rises.
A deaf boy in Tiruttani was hit by a train while going to relieve himself in the open due to a missing toilet, and the office should inspect sanitation facilities.
Rainwater mixed with sewage at the Ambattur Industrial Estate, and the office must coordinate with civic authorities to clear the waterlogging immediately.
Plans for a new flyover and infrastructure on the Radial Road are being considered to ease traffic and protect the Pallikaranai marshland, which the office should review.
Adyar police arrested a history-sheeter for robbing twenty-four lakh rupees from a sales manager, and the office should monitor local crime prevention measures.
Collectorate office operations in Thiruvallur were severely disrupted by a power outage, and the office should ensure backup power systems are operational.
Auto drivers protested in Gummidipoondi against free bus travel affecting their livelihoods, and the office should monitor transport union grievances.
Police seized one ton of smuggled gutka and tobacco in a container lorry in Gummidipoondi, and the office should watch ongoing police investigations.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay inaugurated CapitaLand's nineteen hundred forty crore rupee data centre in Ambattur, and the office should support further tech investments.
NITI Aayog proposed linking data centre clearances to power and water availability, and the office should review these guidelines for future state approvals.
Central intelligence officers arrested a TVK functionary in a multi-crore methamphetamine smuggling case, and the office should monitor developments closely.
DMK President M.K. Stalin criticized the TVK government over removing the Naan Mudhalvan scheme name, and the office should prepare responses to opposition statements.
